functions.name: fireTimeoutCallback
functions.notes: Fires one client timer from the libc++-style unordered map at 7932796, invoking the callback through vtable byte offset 24, re-looking up after the callback, unlinking with predecessor bucket-clear/next rehash rules, decrementing the live count, destroying the callback through slot 4/5 and freeing entry+node. Null callback aborts through 406.

validation.comparison: Eleven map scenarios: empty, absent, power-of-two hit, collision first/second node, next-node rehash, duplicate id, self callback, normal callback, null-callback trap, lazy initialization and bucket-array OOB. Each compares outcome/error constructor+message, complete 67,108,864-byte memory and the stack pointer; callback cases assert four host invocations across native+hook runs.
limitations: Guard acquire returning 0 is not exercised.
A callback that mutates/rehashes the map between invocation and the second lookup is implemented but only exercised on an unchanged map.
Chain node equal to the sentinel, node+12==0 and out-of-bounds chain nodes are not exercised.
Ledger: 439 client bodies recovered and 3,806 remain machine code.
